arStrings.szText: {c_important}Flame Shield{/c} instantly scorches close enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and Immobilizing them for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADEA_IMMOBILIZE}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Flame Shield{/c} rains down {c_number}[1 / SF_13]{/c} {u}{c_important}Meteorites{/c}{/u} per second that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_METEORITE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Flame Shield{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast.

Instead of becoming {u}{c_important}Immune{/c}{/u} you embody lightning, generating {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} per second and gaining {c_number}[SF_31 * 100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed and {c_number}[SF_32 * 100|1%|]{/c} Dodge.
While {c_important}Flame Shield{/c} is active, you heal for {c_number}[SF_7 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_7]){/c} per second.
{c_important}Flame Shield's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Flame Shield's{/c} duration is increased to {c_number}[SF_0+SF_42|1|]{/c} seconds.
